description: Input [numbers,k]. Return maximum minus minimum for every consecutive width-k window, in order.
For each index, return the sum of every other integer in the input list. An empty list returns [].
parent_response:
def solve(data):
    return [sum(data[i::2]) for i in range(2)] if data else []
solution:
def solve(data):
    return [sum(data) - x for x in data] if data else []
